promotions.evidence: Fresh PostgreSQL create, revise, and readback preserve target outcome, date, status, milestone, and revisions 1 through 3.
One synthetic Person is a candidate in a recruiting Pursuit and a buyer in a sales Pursuit without duplicating identity.
A Gap persists an explicit user-authored basis and close condition; an evidence-supported Gap with no reviewed reference is rejected.
An internal Action reads back owner, drafted status, due time, and a database-enforced empty external-effects array; a cross-workspace owner is rejected.
Recruiting and sales fixtures pass through the same request, storage, response, revision, and receipt contracts.
Two concurrent expected-revision writes produce exactly one applied revision and one PURSUIT_REVISION_CONFLICT; a stale client is also rejected.
Create and revise return persisted structured receipts whose operation readback is byte-equivalent at the JSON value level.

unchanged_limits: V1-SEC-001 remains partial overall until iOS cache/outbox and Agent run scope are proven, although the Pursuit API subset passed isolation tests.
V1-AGT-005 remains implemented but unverified for the final Agent tool manifest; the Pursuit Action schema itself enforces no external effects.
The baseline safety/mobile veto remains active until Proposal review and iOS render applied success only from this canonical operation readback.
